scope: Actual hosted screenshots, fictional group and studio, PayPal sandbox. Original pixels copied after visual review. No credentials, login screens, provider account details or invitation URLs.

frames.title: Private limits, a real decision
frames.caption: Alex wants to form a cup and has a $50 limit. The $72 wheel session exceeds it; the published $48 hand-build session can fit. Other people never see Alex’s private limit.

frames.title: Ask before interpreting
frames.caption: Sam’s fictional note says “I leave Friday.” Only with Sam’s permission does the note and public studio catalog go to Astropods. Budgets and the group’s details stay out.

frames.title: One grounded question
frames.caption: In this recorded run, the AI asked about collection: same-day pickup, self-collection later, or collection by a friend. Sam confirms the meaning. The model cannot invent a session, volunteer a friend or approve a payment.

frames.title: An answer is not someone else’s agreement
frames.caption: Sam chooses Jordan. Before sharing, Sam explicitly agrees to disclose the collection arrangement to Jordan and, if booked, the studio.

frames.title: Wait for the other person
frames.caption: Jordan has not agreed yet. The arrangement cannot count toward an offer until Jordan accepts it.

frames.title: A session fits everyone
frames.caption: Jordan agrees. The deterministic planner checks the group’s confirmed choices and the published catalog. Thursday hand-building at $48 per person is now a group candidate.

frames.title: The studio makes the reservation
frames.caption: The studio reviews the exact activity, six-person roster, collection agreement, buffered calendar time and cancellation terms. It explicitly permits automatic collection after all payments qualify.

frames.title: One frozen offer for the group
frames.caption: The studio reserves the session and opens a two-hour approval window. Each person reviews the same immutable price and terms. The group is not booked yet.

frames.title: Everyone approves their own share
frames.caption: Alex opens PayPal sandbox to approve $48. Each of the six friends uses a distinct sandbox buyer. No friend is charged for another person’s share.

frames.title: A hold comes before collection
frames.caption: Alex’s authorization is verified. It has not been captured. Rally waits for all six qualified authorizations before starting collection.

frames.title: Six captures, one confirmed booking
frames.caption: The hosted run completed six $48 captures, $288 gross. Only after every capture was independently verified did Rally confirm the booking and keep the studio reservation booked.

frames.title: Each friend sees their own completed payment
frames.caption: Sam’s own payment is complete and the shared booking is confirmed. Six authorization and six capture webhooks were processed. A delivered duplicate left the original receipt and financial state unchanged.
